calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-10-04' AS as_of_end),
tampere AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900),
ver AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.home_store_id FROM dim_member m, params p
  WHERE p.as_of_end BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key, params p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM ver WHERE home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere)) AS all_members_tampere_home,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ver v JOIN active a USING (member_id) WHERE v.home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere)) AS active_members_tampere_home,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ver) AS all_members_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM ver GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_versions_on_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere) AND is_current) AS current_version_tampere

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-10-04' AS as_of_end),
ver AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.home_store_id, m.join_date FROM dim_member m, params p
  WHERE p.as_of_end BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key, params p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end)
SELECT v.home_store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS members, COUNT(a.member_id) AS active, MAX(v.join_date) AS latest_join
FROM ver v LEFT JOIN active a USING (member_id)
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = v.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' OR v.home_store_id IN (900, 999)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
